name: a5
description: Millimeter-accurate, equal-area global geospatial index based on a pentagonal geodesic grid. 31 resolution levels from continental scale down to sub-30 mm² precision, optimized for spatial aggregation, filtering, and joins.

cta.title: Index the World with A5
cta.description: Install the A5 extension to use a global, equal-area pentagonal grid for spatial aggregation and joins inside DuckDB.

quickStart:
-- Get the A5 cell for Times Square at resolution 15
SELECT a5_lonlat_to_cell(-74.0060, 40.7128, 15) AS nyc_cell;

-- Aggregate point data spatially
SELECT a5_lonlat_to_cell(longitude, latitude, 15) AS cell_id,
       COUNT(*) AS point_count
FROM points
GROUP BY cell_id
ORDER BY point_count DESC;
